fusions.name: Chewing Through
fusions.desc: Chews into the target for 7 damage and leaves it 6% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 5 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Famine Wave
fusions.desc: Sweeps over every enemy within 3.5 tiles, dealing 32 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Swarm Frenzy
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 12 seconds. A swarm fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Trailing Cloud
fusions.desc: A bonded cloud of locusts trails you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.
